title: Setup database reset page accessible without authentication
description: The /setup.php page which can create/reset the database and reset admin credentials to 'admin//password' is accessible without any authentication. An unauthenticated attacker could reset the database and credentials.
poc:
Probe request against http://127.0.0.1:8080/setup.php; observed proving result from prior stage handoff:

Database Setup

Click on the 'Create / Reset Database' button below to create or reset your database.
